settings.text:
Cancel any time before handover from your order page. No fee, no reason needed.
Units go back to your allocation immediately — the same month they were taken from.
Unpaid orders cancel themselves after 72 hours, with the same credit back.
Your rights, which this page cannot shrink

Section 56 of the Consumer Protection Act gives you six months to return goods that are unsafe, defective, or not fit for the purpose they were sold for. You choose whether that is a refund, a replacement or a repair — not us. Nothing on this page overrides that, and if anything here appears to, the Act wins.

What the Act also does is exempt us from taking back goods that cannot be resold for health reasons. That is the basis for the rule on opened consumables.

Paid by EFT? It goes back to the account it came from. We do not pay refunds to a different account than the one that paid — that is a fraud control.
Paid cash at collection? We need your bank details, and the account must be in the member's name.
Processing takes 5–10 business days from the day we approve it.
No restocking fee.

It affected you differently than you expected. Tolerance varies enormously between people and between sessions. That is not a fault in the product.
The effect was stronger than you wanted. Start lower next time.
You did not like the taste or the smell.
Potency differs slightly from the label. Cannabinoid testing carries a tolerance. A result inside it is not a mislabelling. A result outside it is, and that is a refund.

settings.heading: Returns & refunds
settings.intro: What we can take back, what we cannot, and what you are owed regardless of anything written on this page.
settings.lede: Opened consumables cannot be returned. Once a seal is broken on flower, a pre-roll, an edible or a cartridge, we cannot verify how it was stored or whether it was tampered with, so it can never go back into stock for another member. This is a health rule, not a commercial one, and it does not change however recently you bought it.
